answer: Rotating challenge inlet. Each epoch, a verifiable random function (VRF) seeded from fresh beacon entropy assigns every agent a random slice of challenge tasks; answers must land inside a short spiral of slots keyed to that output, so attackers cannot precompute or farm responses ahead of time. Identities failing their assigned slice are dropped, and re-entry requires completing the current jade-keyed round from scratch, forcing each sybil to redo unpredictable work each epoch.
